sql: SELECT 'live' AS src, o.created_at, o.market_ticker, o.side, o.action, o.limit_price::text AS price, o.quantity::text AS qty, o.status, coalesce(o.kalshi_order_id,'-') AS koid FROM live_orders o WHERE o.strategy = 'Alimm1' UNION ALL SELECT 'twin', p.created_at, p.market_ticker, p.side, p.action, p.assumed_price::text, p.quantity::text, p.status, '-' FROM paper_trades p WHERE p.strategy = 'Alimm1_pt3' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30
